data:
FSC.quadratic_remainder (u e U E : ℝ) (hU : U ≠ 0) (hE : E ≠ 0) (hX : U + E ≠ 0) :
  u ^ 2 / U + e ^ 2 / E - (u + e) ^ 2 / (U + E) = (E * u - U * e) ^ 2 / ((U + E) * U * E)
FSC.quadratic_split_le (u e U E : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (hE : 0 < E) : (u + e) ^ 2 / (U + E) ≤ u ^ 2 / U + e ^ 2 / E

FSC.componentwise_compare.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (u e omega : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
  (hu : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < u i) (he : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < e i) (ho : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < omega i) (hM : 0 < M)
  (homega : ∑ i, omega i = 1) (hcomp : ∀ (i : ι), (u i + e i) ^ 2 / M - u i ^ 2 / ∑ j, u j ≥ omega i * e i) :
  M ≤ ∑ i, (u i + e i)

FSC.componentwise_equality.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (u e omega : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
  (hu : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < u i) (he : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < e i) (_ho : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < omega i) (hM : 0 < M)
  (homega : ∑ i, omega i = 1) (hcomp : ∀ (i : ι), (u i + e i) ^ 2 / M - u i ^ 2 / ∑ j, u j ≥ omega i * e i)
  (heq : ∑ i, (u i + e i) = M) (i : ι) : u i / ∑ j, u j = omega i ∧ e i / ∑ j, e j = omega i ∧ u i + e i = M * omega i

FSC.componentwise_compare.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype.{u_1} ι] [Nonempty.{u_1 + 1} ι] (u e omega : ι → Real)
  (M : Real)
  (hu :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) (u i))
  (he :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) (e i))
  (ho :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) (omega i))
  (hM : @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) M)
  (homega :
    @Eq.{1} Real
      (@Finset.sum.{u_1, 0} ι Real Real.instAddCommMonoid (@Finset.univ.{u_1} ι inst✝) fun (i : ι) => omega i)
      (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 1) (@One.toOfNat1.{0} Real Real.instOne)))
  (hcomp :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      @GE.ge.{0} Real Real.instLE
        (@HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHSub.{0} Real Real.instSub)
          (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))
            (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Nat Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Nat (@Monoid.toPow.{0} Real Real.instMonoid))
              (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHAdd.{0} Real Real.instAdd) (u i) (e i))
              (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))))
            M)
          (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))
            (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Nat Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Nat (@Monoid.toPow.{0} Real Real.instMonoid))
              (u i) (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))))
            (@Finset.sum.{u_1, 0} ι Real Real.instAddCommMonoid (@Finset.univ.{u_1} ι inst✝) fun (j : ι) => u j)))
        (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul) (omega i) (e i))) :
  @LE.le.{0} Real Real.instLE M
    (@Finset.sum.{u_1, 0} ι Real Real.instAddCommMonoid (@Finset.univ.{u_1} ι inst✝) fun (i : ι) =>
      @HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHAdd.{0} Real Real.instAdd) (u i) (e i))

FSC.componentwise_equality.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype.{u_1} ι] [Nonempty.{u_1 + 1} ι] (u e omega : ι → Real)
  (M : Real)
  (hu :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) (u i))
  (he :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) (e i))
  (_ho :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) (omega i))
  (hM : @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)) M)
  (homega :
    @Eq.{1} Real
      (@Finset.sum.{u_1, 0} ι Real Real.instAddCommMonoid (@Finset.univ.{u_1} ι inst✝) fun (i : ι) => omega i)
      (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 1) (@One.toOfNat1.{0} Real Real.instOne)))
  (hcomp :
    ∀ (i : ι),
      @GE.ge.{0} Real Real.instLE
        (@HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHSub.{0} Real Real.instSub)
          (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))
            (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Nat Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Nat (@Monoid.toPow.{0} Real Real.instMonoid))
              (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHAdd.{0} Real Real.instAdd) (u i) (e i))
              (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))))
            M)
          (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))
            (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Nat Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Nat (@Monoid.toPow.{0} Real Real.instMonoid))
              (u i) (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))))
            (@Finset.sum.{u_1, 0} ι Real Real.instAddCommMonoid (@Finset.univ.{u_1} ι inst✝) fun (j : ι) => u j)))
        (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul) (omega i) (e i)))
  (heq :
    @Eq.{1} Real
      (@Finset.sum.{u_1, 0} ι Real Real.instAddCommMonoid (@Finset.univ.{u_1} ι inst✝) fun (i : ι) =>
        @HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHAdd.{0} Real Real.instAdd) (u i) (e i))
      M)
  (i : ι) :
  And
    (@Eq.{1} Real
      (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))

      (omega i))
    (And
      (@Eq.{1} Real
        (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))
          (e i) (@Finset.sum.{u_1, 0} ι Real Real.instAddCommMonoid (@Finset.univ.{u_1} ι inst✝) fun (j : ι) => e j))
        (omega i))
      (@Eq.{1} Real (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHAdd.{0} Real Real.instAdd) (u i) (e i))
        (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul) M (omega i))))
